title: Cecil Brower, Kenneth Pitts, the TCU teacher and Parker Wilson's push for prestige
summary: The two Doughboys violinists studied at TCU and arranged for Parker to meet a piano teacher, a turning point. Parker Wilson wanted more prestige than a hillbilly band had, which motivated the group to prove its music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school
